title: Chuymanïñan Kusisiñ Yatiyäwi
intro: Mä ratukiw suytʼäwix wasitat sartaski uk uñjasktaxa. Mä chacha warmixa, nayratpachaw awk taykäñat sipansa, mä arsüwi katuqapxi, uka arsutax naturaleza tuqit kamachinakaruw jan yäqkiti. Jupanak taypinx mä uñacht’äwiw sayt’atäski, jupan utjatapax Diosan khuyapayasiñap uñacht’ayi, mä almaw profetjam utt’ayatäna, mä herencia apt’ata, ukax walja maranakaw utjani. ¿Khitis uka muspharkañ jaqejja?
clues: Nayajj chuymankipstat awk taykatwa nasiyäta, jupanakajj janiw wawanïpkänti.
Nayan yurïwijajj angelanakaw yatiyapjjäna, jupanakajj familiajaruw invitadonakjam jutapjjarakïna.
Yatiñampi profetjam uñtʼatäñampiw churapjjetäna, ukat usut jaqenak taypinwa nayat parli.
Tatajajj Allahan amigopawa sasaw sapjjerïna, ukat qhepa maranakanjja jupatakejj mä regalopunïnwa.
Mä jilataw utjäna, jupax profetarakïnwa, panpachaniw Tatitusan bendicionap katuqapxta.
Wawajajj profetarakïnwa, wawanakajarojj Qellqatampi, profetjam uñtʼatäñampiw churapjjäna.

arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
verse: Praise to Allāh, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication. (14:39)
